items.text: Puka Nacua listed GTD/OPTIMISM then confirmed ACTIVE for Week 7 vs Raiders after calf injury; Schefter and Rapoport corroborated official active status.
items.why: Rams optimistic post-Saturday improvement; no setbacks.
items.implication: Full WR1 usage expected; reverse any Davante Adams/Higbee beneficiary stashes from prior uncertainty.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets as primary in Stafford offense

items.text: Breece Hall GTD/PESSIMISM then officially INACTIVE for Week 7 (quad); Rapoport confirmed unlikely then inactive after limited practice.
items.why: Not full participant yet after missing three games; early for return.
items.implication: Braelon Allen continues workhorse role; handcuff/backup elevated.

items.text: Saquon Barkley EXPECTED TO PLAY then confirmed ACTIVE for MNF vs Cowboys (hamstring return); Schefter/Rapoport noted active with Eagles activations.
items.why: Returned to practice; expected and listed active.
items.implication: RB1 workload restored; reverse any backup elevation.
items.opportunity: Carries, red-zone, snaps in Eagles offense

items.text: Lamar Jackson OUT for Week 7 (ankle); third straight miss, confirmed in ETR summary and beat reports.
items.why: Limited practice but ruled out again.
items.implication: Huntley starts; Flowers/Henry usage shifts without Lamar dual-threat.

items.text: Jonah Coleman LOVE/upgrade: first game back led Broncos RB snaps 50%, rush 41%, routes 34%; Dobbins only 21% snaps, Harvey fluky TD. Preseason call validated.
items.implication: Roster/start as Broncos lead back; Dobbins downgraded.

items.text: Cam Skattebo actually hurt (hamstring) but uncertain extent; Levitan on ETR Sunday watch list.
items.implication: Monitor for next week; potential Tracy or backup opportunity.
items.opportunity: If out, Giants RB snaps expand for others

items.text: Jahmyr Gibbs ankle (turned on purposeful slide) almost certainly fine per Levitan; would have been tilting if truly injured avoiding TD.
items.why: Purposeful slide; Levitan assessment post-ETR watch list.
items.implication: No major downgrade; continue RB1 usage.

items.text: DeVonta Smith and Dontayvion Wicks OUT; ETR listed, impacting Eagles pass game on MNF with Saquon active.
items.implication: Increased targets to remaining pass-catchers (e.g. slot options); Berry noted Lemon opportunity.
items.opportunity: Routes/targets for Eagles WRs/TEs without Smith/Wicks

items.text: Josh Jacobs IN/active after return; ETR listed among INs, Berry discussing ROS value post-return.
items.implication: Workload return; monitor snap share vs committee.

items.text: Tee Higgins: Can we PLEASE put some respect on his name? Berry upgrade/respect call post-performance.
items.why: Strong play deserving more fantasy respect.
items.implication: Higher start/ROS consideration in Bengals WR corps.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty epitome of high-value touch thesis: worst runner efficiency (last in YPC 3.1, poor EPA/RYOE) but RB13 PPR via 9 inside-5 carries + 45 targets (leads RBs).
items.implication: Sustainable fantasy RB2/flex despite poor YPC; continue starting.

items.text: Tony Pollard EXPLODED Sunday; Berry recommends sell-high if possible for fantasy value.
items.implication: Trade for more stable assets; not sustainable every week.

items.text: Texans WR routes on 29 Stroud dropbacks: Nico Collins 24 lead, Tank Dell only 6 (first game since 2024, limited return); Noel left early turf toe.
items.implication: Nico clear alpha; Dell ramp slow.

items.text: Xavier Worthy 33 routes (lead) on 36 Mahomes dropbacks in second game without Rashee Rice; note never topped 83 rec yds in 37 games.
items.implication: High ceiling opportunity but historical yardage cap; monitor targets.
items.conflict: Historical ceiling <83 yds limits boom potential
